contact.basis: Fixed eastern entrance approach point from the scaled historical plan, chosen before terrain acquisition. Current terrain is context only, never an1880grade survey; exact historicground/host contact is unverified.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in printed-plan north frame at the approximate former-site point. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact historicalground/wallfoot classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
